Welcome to Join
About the Session

An Afternoon of Open Exchange

Following the closed-door institutional session in the morning, the Open Door Session in the afternoon welcomes a broader higher education community to meet Chinese university representatives, discover opportunities for academic and educational cooperation, and exchange ideas about the future of Sino-Hellenic higher education relations.

Bringing together different perspectives, interests and opportunities under the wider framework of the Sino-Hellenic Higher Education Summit.

Who It Is For

Who is the Open Door Session for?

The afternoon session welcomes:

Students

Interested in study opportunities and international academic experiences in China.

Researchers & Academics

Interested in research collaboration and academic exchange with Chinese institutions.

University Staff

Internationalisation professionals interested in cooperation with Chinese institutions.

HE Professionals

Representatives interested in Sino-Hellenic academic relations and institutional cooperation.

Open to All

Anyone with an interest in higher education cooperation between Greece and China.

A Meeting of Two Worlds

Greece & China

Two ancient civilisations with deep intellectual traditions meet at Harokopio University of Athens to build the future of higher education cooperation.

Greece

Cradle of Western philosophy and learning, host of the Summit

China

Home to participating universities, research strengths and study opportunities

Direct Engagement

Meet Chinese Universities

The Open Door Session will provide an opportunity to engage directly with representatives of participating Chinese universities.

Discover their academic programmes, research strengths and international opportunities, and explore possibilities for future connection and cooperation.

Whether you are considering studying in China, looking for research or academic collaboration, or simply interested in learning more about Chinese higher education, the Open Door Session offers an opportunity to connect directly with institutions and their representatives.

Whether you are a student looking for your next international opportunity, an academic exploring new research connections, or a higher education professional interested in developing institutional cooperation, you are welcome to join us.
